rv.q: All six cast members delighted the large contingent of toddlers at the Lortel, but somehow Owen’s rubber-faced, space-gobbling, anarchic clowning felt like its own lesson.

The stage explodes with vibrant color, whimsical catchy songs, and a “supa-dupa” talented cast of 6 performers that bring barrels of laughs, voice chops, and silly fun to the stage for a rollicking 70 minutes.
Del Aguila and Alexander’s clever and well-delivered songs advance these objectives.

cn.t: Critics praise this lively adaptation of Dav Pilkey's series for its cheeky humor and energetic songs, delivering the blasting good time audiences expect from TheaterWorksUSA's award-winning productions for young families.
